poems.line: Friedrich Schiller, Gedichte (de.wikisource transcriptions of first prints, de.wikisource transcriptions poem by poem; each page's Textdaten names its own first print or edition (Thalia 1786 and 1789, Musen-Almanach 1796–1800, Gedichte 1804, later editions 1808, 1852, 1854 where no first print is held).
